symptom: A PATH entry holding a literal backslash-n (one mistyped /etc/paths.d line) made the login-shell probe return only the text after it, so Design build style sources and other repository scripts failed with "node: command not found" (exit 127) until Zeros restarted.
rule: Print a probed value with printf '%s\n', never echo: zsh, dash and macOS /bin/sh expand backslash sequences. Run the real probe command through the shells each placement meets (zsh and /bin/sh on macOS, bash and dash on Linux) without startup files. See the login-shell-path-printf change fragment.
